name: LCD I2C Display 20x4
desc: This example demonstrates how to use a 20x4 LCD display with an I2C backpack (PCF8574) to display text and a counter. The wiring is straightforward: connect the LCD's VCC to 5V, GND to GND, SDA to A4, and SCL to A5 on the Arduino Uno. The code initializes the LCD, displays a welcome message, and continuously updates a counter on the second line of the display.
